lines.x: The Colombian government's 'Ley de Rescate' tax package reached its 100-day milestone as ministers push to balance public accounts while debating tax contributions from workers and businesses.
Colombia's National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD) approved 7.71 trillion pesos ($1.9 billion) to finance 63 recovery projects across 778 municipalities.
